recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, macro-scale portrait of a man wearing dark sunglasses, where the right lens acts as a portal showing a bright beach scene with figures in swimwear. The image features high-contrast lighting, visible skin texture, and a distinct 1960s color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, shadowed face vs. the bright, saturated reflection
The smooth curve of the sunglass frame vs. the organic texture of the skin
The left lens in deep shadow vs. the right lens as a narrative window
coreInvariants: Macro crop focusing on nose, mouth, and eyes
Reflection contained strictly within the lens boundary
Warm, sun-drenched skin tones contrasted with cool blue water in the reflection

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face fills the entire frame, slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The right sunglass lens containing the beach reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright reflection in the right lens, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then to the typography on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left side of the face and within the left lens.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm terracotta and orange skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the sunglasses and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and pale blue from the ocean and sky in the reflection.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the shadow side of the face and the high-key beach reflection.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 1960s film stock saturation levels

composition.position: Left-center, overlapping the dark left lens
composition.relationshipToImage: High contrast white/cyan text on black background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with color variation to distinguish title from artist.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo box in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 60s/70s aesthetic and tight tracking.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of a man's face in warm sunlight, wearing black 1960s style sunglasses. The right lens must show a clear, bright reflection of a sunny beach with people in vintage swimwear. The left lens should be in deep shadow. High skin texture detail.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply geometric sans-serif text in white and light cyan, left-aligned, over the dark area of the left sunglass lens. Add a small square logo and technical metadata in the top left corner in a smaller font size.

verificationChecks: Is the reflection confined to the lens?
Is the skin texture realistic and high-contrast?
Is the typography geometric and tightly spaced?
Does the color palette feel like 1960s film?

postGenerationChecks: Check for lens distortion in the reflection
Ensure the text is legible against the dark lens
Verify the 1960s era-appropriate swimwear in the reflection
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Portrait + Thematic Lens Reflection + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay
